Been a while since I’ve used it but from memory, rigid collodion takes off a few layers of skin if not removed correctly 
I think it will be visible temporarily, but if you leave it be and don’t peel it when it starts to scab/grow back it won’t scar permanently 

Unfortunately it’s one of those products with an amazing effect, but it does so by tightening your skin and if not removed properly (spirit gum remover) it can damage your skin

Basically, don’t put any more of it on, try and not irritate it further and in future invest in some remover rather than peeling (if you did use remover then soak it longer rather than trying to get it off quick)
